about: What user-flow judges each H3 15 s Turbo clip against (8 steps: 4 dense, then 4 sparse), per SKU x GPUs: a run more than 5% slower fails (Paul 11-15: within 5% is a tie). Cold only with cold (tfs-299): `cold_exec_s` is a pod's first request of the function, judged against a machine's first request in the flow; `warm_exec_s` a later one on the same executor, judged against a machine's later requests. `new_executor_exec_s` is a new executor's first request on a pod that had already run the function (its weights cached, its LoRA bakes, memos and learned peaks there): neither cold nor warm, so recorded and never judged. With no cold figure a machine's first request is a note, not a fail. The 0.25.0 gates, cozy 0.25.0, Runtime 0.46.0, minimax-h3@0.12.0 on its int8 lane: rtx-4090 from release-gate 43217306537 (shirayuki, TensorFS 0.25.0; runs 9-12 one GPU, 13-16 two: x1's cold is run 9, the pod's first H3 run; x2's 225.1 is run 13, after runs 9-12 on the same pod), rtx-5090 from 43233812383 (roxas, TensorFS 0.25.1; cold is run 9, the pod's first, as the tracker's runtime-releases.md 0.25.0 line gives it; 240.3 is the median of runs 9, 13, 15 and 17, three of them after runs 9 and 10 on the same pod; warm 10). Dense is steps 2-4, sparse steps 5-8, medians. h100x1 is Paul's word (11-16): a 15 s H3 Turbo clip in about 6 min on one H100. A function or SKU with no entry is recorded, not judged: its first green run's numbers go here.
